name: 29620 · Abbeville, SC
findings: ZIP 29620 (Abbeville) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29620 (Abbeville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 29620 (Abbeville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
